bs_first_ride: The shuttle hums to a stop. Nobody asks for a ticket. Nobody asks your name, either.
hs_first_drop: The shuttle sets you down beside the Lantern Coach. Its driver waves at the porter. He doesn't wave back.
bg_f2_arrive: Floor two. Rows of desks face one board. Every chair is pushed in.
bg_bench_rest: You sit on the bench by the door. {pet} leans on your boots and gets its breath back.
seal4: Storms aren't stopped, Cadet. They're moved.

lines.intro: Volt rule one: go first or get hit first. Pick.
lines.win: You went first. That's the whole lesson.
lines.lose: Hit first, lost first. Rest, then pick again.

lines.intro: Losing the race? Swap out. A fresh start is still a start.
lines.win: You swapped at the right time. Good read.
lines.lose: Stayed in too long. Rest, and trade sooner.

lines.intro: Behind? A good type edge wins from behind. Show me.
lines.win: From behind, too. Told you a type edge holds.
lines.lose: No edge, no comeback. Rest, and bring one.

lines.intro: This Hall was built for storms. Now I make my own weather. Show me yours, Cadet.
lines.win: Clean strike, {player}. Nearest thing to real lightning I've seen in years.
lines.lose: A beat too slow. Storms don't wait. Rest, and come back charged.

lines.intro: Top ten this quarter or bust! You'd look great as a number on my chart.
lines.win: Down a place. I'll call it growth.
lines.lose: Targets up! Rest, then let's go again.

lines.intro: The quay's been quiet since the barges went electric. A battle'll do.
lines.lose: Tide's mine today. Rest a while.

lines.intro: Off to the storm hall? Take clay. A spark won't touch a grounded jug.
lines.win: Fired well, {player}. Ada will feel that.
lines.lose: Cracked in the kiln. Rest, then try again.

lines.intro: Same house, same lamp, same smile. Want to see my company Walklings?
lines.win: Bright work. I'll put it in my review.
lines.lose: See? Everything runs on time here. Rest up.
